name: Original Message 1
definition: Identification of a message previously sent.

From.name: From
From.definition: Message sender specified in the original message.

To.name: To
To.definition: Message recipient specified in the original message.

BusinessMessageIdentifier.name: Business Message Identifier
BusinessMessageIdentifier.definition: Message identification specified in the original message.

CreationDate.name: Creation Date
CreationDate.definition: Message creation date and time specified in the original message.

CopyDuplicate.name: Copy Duplicate
CopyDuplicate.definition: Indicates whether the message is a copy, a duplicate or a copy of a duplicate of a previously sent ISO 20022 message.
